messages.subject: ISM
parts:
Hi Vincent,

Hope all is well. A couple questions related to idle sleep mode:

1) Is there a way to flag periods where idle sleep mode was detected/imputed? 
2) If so, does this flag gets outputted as part of the time series file? 

We're using the latest GGIR version 2.6.6. 

Thanks,
Pedro

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] ISM
parts:
Hi Pedro,
Good question, I am afraid GGIR does not have this yet. I agree that it would be a good addition. I think ActiGraph file header does not clarify whether idle sleep mode was used, so I think we will have to use the knowledge about whether timegaps were found in the data.
Thanks,
Vincent
